lines.en: Bones make noise when they walk.
I pace out the shooting range.
My shoulder blades clack in the wind.
Every three steps I raise the bow.
Grass snaps brittle under my feet.
Light bones walk faster than flesh.
Wind through my ribs makes a low note.
My quiver rattles wherever I go.
I am looking for high ground.
Don't follow me; you will block my shots.

lines.zh: 脚步声太吵，容易露位置。
lines.en: My footsteps are loud and give me away.
I walk straight and never detour.
The bowstring whispers against my back.
This distance is just right to draw.

lines.zh: 我边走边从背上抽出一支箭
lines.en: I draw an arrow from my back as I walk.

lines.zh: 骨头踩进湿土，拔出来响一下
lines.en: My bone sinks in wet soil and pops free.
I lay out my arrows one by one.
My bones hold a hollow echo.

lines.zh: 站着的时候我也在瞄准。
lines.en: Even standing, I am still aiming.
The string went slack; I must retighten it.
No flesh, so the cold never bites.
I am counting how many steps you took.
The fletching on this arrow is curling.

lines.zh: 头骨里装不下太多想法。
lines.en: My skull has little room for thoughts.
I am waiting for the wind to settle.
A steady stance makes an accurate shot.

lines.zh: 身上的骨头都是自己的。
lines.en: Every bone on me is my own.
Something moved far off; I note it.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，在我的准星里。
lines.en: Your eyes sit inside my sights.
I am judging how far ahead to aim.
Stay still; moving makes me calculate.
Your armor leaves the neck bare.
I stare long because I must be accurate.
That sword in your hand is far too short.

lines.zh: 我们之间这段空地，刚好。
lines.en: This open ground between us is perfect.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我当成了靶。
lines.en: I am using your shadow as a target.

lines.zh: 别退到树后，我换个角度。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the tree; I will shift angle.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，估你的动作。
lines.en: I count your breaths to predict your move.
It hurts, but bones do not cry out.
One snapped; there are others.
The shaft split; I switch to another.
Break me? You must get close first.
Cracked bone still draws a bow.
A loose shoulder blade is a nuisance.
Do not assume I only retreat.
Endure it; I owe you an arrow.
Pain travels slowly through bone. Convenient.
One more step and I release the string.
I do not eat; bones do not eat.
Holding arrows? That saves me trouble.
Bones? I am already made of them.
Don't wave bread; I can see through it.

lines.zh: 你要是举着弓，我会走过来。
lines.en: Raise a bow and I will come closer.
Food cannot fill the gaps in bones.
Fletching and shafts, I know them well.
That one in your hand looks new.
Hold it higher so I can see the head.
I will not turn my back for a meal.
Bump me and you will hear bones clatter.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上了我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my ribcage.
Don't shove; this frame is fragile.
I take one step back and brace better.

lines.zh: 碰一下就散架？你想多了。
lines.en: Fall apart from one bump? Not likely.
Bone against bone makes a ringing sound.
Give me space; I need to draw.
You are between me and the target.
I am this thin; can you even move me?
Change positions; this angle is bad.

lines.zh: 两个骷髅站一起，像副骨架。
lines.en: Two skeletons side by side look like one frame.

lines.zh: 我们不需要血肉，也能并肩。
lines.en: We need no flesh to stand together.

lines.zh: 我的弓可以借你拉一次。
lines.en: You may draw my bow once.
Bone tapping bone is how we greet.
Stand farther; I might snap you in half.

lines.zh: 我们生下来的也是骨头。
lines.en: What we bring forth is also bone.
Loosing arrows together feels right.
Do not raise your bow at me; it is rude.
There is wind here, good for standing together.
I offer no soft words, only arrows.
I will keep the arrows; nothing wasted.
This bone looks a lot like mine.
Pick it up and slot it in the quiver.
Few fingers make a weak grip.
Could what you dropped serve as arrows?
I line the loose stones up in a row.
Don't drop arrowheads; they are precious.
My bones creak when I bend over.
This is light enough to weight a shaft.
Stow it; I will need it soon.

lines.zh: 你正站在我算好的点上。
lines.en: You are standing on my calculated point.
The bow is drawn; hold still.
I lock on with my eyes alone.
This arrow has your position written on it.
The iron on you will block one shot.
Legs first, then the head.
Don't stand in the open; there is no time.
Thirty blocks away. Just right.

lines.zh: 我的骨头知道该往哪瞄。
lines.en: My bones know where to point.
Once seen, you are not leaving.
Did you hear the string release?
This first arrow only tests the wind.
I chase slowly but shoot very far.
Run, and I will calculate where you land.
I walk and draw at the same time.
You circle the tree; I take the slope.
Don't stop; stopping lets me aim.
The arrowhead stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你的影子跑到哪，我跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever your shadow runs, I follow.
No need to charge; I have plenty of arrows.
You will slow down going uphill.
Along this path I left three arrows.
Don't hug the wall; ricochets come back.

lines.zh: 我们之间，只剩一个呼吸。
lines.en: Only one breath stands between us.
That punch came from solid bone.
This close, I shoot without aiming.
The bow itself can strike too.
I scratched you with an arrowhead.
My knuckles rap on your armor.
That one was at point blank.
Don't grab my bow; it will snap.
My hand is harder than it looks.
Two steps back; I need to shoot.
Close quarters suits me fine.
Bones rise straight out of the soil.
I open my eyes and look for high ground.

lines.zh: 弓箭是跟着我一起醒的。
lines.en: My bow woke up with me.
This clearing gives me clean sightlines.
I test the string; the tone still rings true.
I plant my feet, then draw the first arrow.
Rising at night, I make little sound.
The bones beneath my feet are old ones.

lines.zh: 我出现的地方，会先安静。
lines.en: Where I appear, silence comes first.
The first arrow is already nocked.
Fire crawls along my ribs slowly.

lines.zh: 散了一地骨头，我慢慢捡。
lines.en: Bones scattered everywhere; I gather them.

lines.zh: 水灌进胸腔，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and I cannot float.

lines.zh: 炸散了一半，我用剩下的站着。
lines.en: Half of me scattered; the rest still stands.

lines.zh: 被自己的箭法打中，丢人。
lines.en: Hit by my own craft. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 药水让骨头变软了一点。
lines.en: The potion softened my bones a little.
I never hunger; I only want to draw.
Lightning lights me up, blinding white.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连骨头都不剩。
lines.en: Fall into the void and not a bone remains.
